scope: Read-only Git push validation through locked typed Python; issue #859 remains unfinished.
preserved_contract: Read local push defaults, compare trimmed values without case sensitivity, and fail on missing or incorrect values.
Recognize hook artifact stems and five extensions in the repository root and .githooks. Preserve ignored, unignored and check-ignore-error classifications. Never delete an artifact.

Inspect container helper configuration only when the existing host checker is present. Invoke the unchanged read-only Bash checker only when a Dev Containers helper is registered. Never invoke a credential helper to retrieve a token.
Anchor Git reads at the selected root even when invoked elsewhere. Keep token and credential permissions unchanged.
stability: Git reads and the owned host checker have 30-second process deadlines and fail visibly.
Artifact diagnostic ordering is deterministic across Python hash seeds.
Unavailable roots, Git and applicable Bash failures cannot report success.
host_boundaries: The frozen original host is case sensitive. The upper-extension alternative for a case-insensitive filesystem is labeled inferred in the fixture; an independent PowerShell literal-path probe verifies the host semantics.

The real container integration runs only when Bash can access repository files. A missing or incompatible host Bash is explicitly skipped for that integration; the applicable missing-Bash validator failure is still tested separately.
The unchanged Bash checker and push-default configuration helpers retain their host contracts; this cohort does not complete their remaining migration scope.

measurement.method: Two warmup pairs then seven alternating fresh-process pairs per fixture size, using isolated Git configuration and temporary repositories. Original and migrated exit statuses and sorted diagnostic lines agree in every observation.
limits: One Linux host with empty disposable system/global credential configuration. Real credential checker integration is correctness-tested separately, not timed here.
No Windows, cold provisioning, full Git push, whole hook or CI performance claim. Seven pairs do not establish statistical significance.
